verdict.rationale: The `npx skills add owner/repo` one-liner is documented and confirmed to work keylessly at runtime, installing skills into agent-specific directories (project or global) that agents load at startup, making them active in the next session; --agent flags target specific coding agents like claude-code/codex/cursor. missing for 10: no independent long-term verification that installed skills persist and activate correctly across many real agent sessions beyond the probe/docs evidence, and community comments raise concerns about lack of clear versioning/uninstall docs.
